stage: Original Task29, prospective scientific-track amendment; not a Gate D speed promotion
clock: At sample k, evaluate ionic and passive currents at imposed V[k] and gate x[k]. Required external current density is C*1e-3*(V[k+1]-V[k])/dt + I_pas(V[k]) + sum_i I_i(V[k],x[k]); inward ionic currents are negative. Then update all 18 gate states with V[k] and imposed cai[k].
primary_comparison: For every family, arm, seed, path and conductance panel compare the frozen hybrid with the exact 11-channel formula baseline on the same imposed V, cai, initial gate state, passive parameters and capacitive term. No model selection, retraining or autonomous voltage.
metric_normalization: Per-channel current errors divide by the channel driving scale gbar*multiplier*(V-E); clamp-demand error divides by |Icap|+|Ipas|+sum_i |gbar_i*multiplier_i*(V-E_i)|, floored at 1e-12. Report absolute mA/cm2 RMSE too; a small normalized total may hide cancellation.
decision: A diagnostic success requires native passive formula agreement and every frozen both-arm family/seed/path/panel below all three limits with zero state occupancy violations. None-arm is a registered ablation, not a rescue or selector. Technical failure is not a scientific NO-GO.
limits: This is an algebraic external-clamp current-budget test, not an authentic full NEURON voltage-clamp trajectory or an autonomous membrane rollout. cai and V remain imposed. Capacitive current is fixed by the prescribed V derivative, and the clamp-demand balance is an identity by construction; only hybrid-vs-formula discrepancies and passive native audit are empirical. No speedup, axial, synaptic, CaDynamics, full-neuron, or Task30 claim.
